description: This file implements a context guard for agent messages, managing message size by truncating or compacting tool results to stay within context size limits, and installing a transform function to enforce these constraints dynamically.

methods.name: truncateTextToBudget
methods.description: Truncates text to fit within a maximum character limit, appending a truncation notice if necessary.

methods.name: replaceToolResultText
methods.description: Replaces the content of an AgentMessage with new text, preserving message structure.

methods.name: truncateToolResultToChars
methods.description: Truncates a tool result message to a maximum number of characters, using caching for efficiency.

methods.name: compactExistingToolResultsInPlace
methods.description: Reduces the size of recent tool result messages in place to meet a character count target.

methods.name: applyMessageMutationInPlace
methods.description: Mutates an AgentMessage in place by replacing its content with another message.

methods.name: enforceToolResultContextBudgetInPlace
methods.description: Ensures all tool results in a message list are within size limits, compacting if necessary.
